messages:
sam_w: Seeing a sharp p99 for Customer A on dedicated pool us-west-2, started ~00:04 UTC after the continuous-batcher rollout. p95 unchanged, p99 jumped from 260ms -> 1.8s. Can we triage? :eyes:
maya_g: on it. do we have traces / example req ids?
alex_k: I rolled out 'cohort-routing' tweak + reduced max_wait_ms from 30 -> 8 in the canary earlier today (deploy 1769989920). leaving note here.
chris_r: attaching a short span snippet from their trace: 
```
span: continuous_batcher.wait -> 1400ms
span: runtime.kv_fetch -> 40ms
span: model.exec -> 120ms
```
looks like the wait node dominates for the slow tails.
deploy-bot: deploy alex_k/cohort-routing v2 -> prod (commit: 9f3a7d) at 1769989920 :rocket:
sam_w: repro steps I used: curl against their tenant with 40 concurrent requests of tiny prompts (~10 tokens) over 60s. p99 reproducible locally against dedicated pool using the same QPS.
maya_g: ok that matches a hold-window starvation case: tiny requests get grouped into cohorts and if cohort routing moves them to a mismatched worker they wait for cohort to fill, then timeout kicks in. not enough traffic to fill cohorts quickly -> long waits.
lenore_p: cost note: increasing max_wait_ms will reduce p99 but increases average in-flight batches -> slightly higher token cost. customer is sensitive but they want latency SLAs.
alex_k: quick mitigation options: 1) revert cohort-routing flag, 2) increase max_wait_ms to 20-30ms, 3) enable tiny-request fastpath (bypass cohort) for prompt tokens < 32.
maya_g: can we hotpatch to 20ms on the dedicated pool for that tenant only? that's the least disruptive.
alex_k: yes, pushing a canary config change now for that tenant: 
```
continuous_batcher:
  cohort_routing: true
  max_wait_ms: 20
  tiny_fastpath_threshold_tokens: 32
```
will roll on dedicated-us-west-2 pool for tenant acme-corp.
chris_r: after the hotpatch i see p99 drop to ~320ms on the sample run (first 5m). p95 stays ~150ms. looks promising.
sam_w: customer notified that we're investigating; they asked for repro steps and ETA. I'll give them ~30m for verification.
maya_g: long term we should add telemetry bucket for tiny-payloads per tenant and auto-fastpath when 95th <= N ms gap. filing follow-up ticket. :memo:
lenore_p: creating cost projection for the fastpath toggle vs SLA credits. will share numbers.
alex_k: logging note: added extra debug tag to traces for "cohort_size" and "route_decision" so we can correlate decisions -> tail waits.
sam_w: update: customer re-tested and confirms latency restored to acceptable levels. leaving thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
